themepack_step1_title: Afɔ 1gɔ́ ɔ: Mi cá ɖò USB jí
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Zǐn nǔxixotɔ́ towe gbɔn Power sín butɔn ɔ xixo gblamɛ.
2. Nú Rockbox bɛ́ azɔ̌ ɔ, sɔ́ kàn USB ɔ dó ɔdinatɛ́ɛ towe mɛ.
3. Enyi è byɔ we ɖò nǔxixo ɔ jí ɔ, hɛn nǔ e ɖò USB Storage mode mɛ é dó ayi mɛ bonu nǔ ɔ ni tɔ́n ɖi mɔ̌to ɖé ɖɔhun.
themepack_step2_title: Afɔ 2gɔ́ ɔ: Sɔ́ Folder ɖebǔ ɖò Player ɔ jí .
themepack_step2_desc: Ðó tutoblonunu e nɔ w’azɔ̌ lɛ é (ɖi macOS) nɔ hwla dotfiles (ɖi .rockbox) ɖò xógbe ɖevo mɛ wutu ɔ, a sixu sɔ́ folder ƉEBU alǒ drive root e ɖò nǔxixotɔ́ towe jí é. Mǐ na mɔ alǒ bló .rockbox sín tɛnmɛ nú we tlɔlɔ.
themepack_status_downloading: Ɖo 360p sin xota ɔ yi ji...
themepack_status_extracting: Mi ɖo xota lɛ ze ɖo .rockbox mɛ...
themepack_complete: È sɔ́ xóta ɔ ɖó tɛn tɔn mɛ ganji! Dìn ɔ, a sixu ɖè nǔxixotɔ́ towe sín kàn ɔ jí kpo ayijayǐ kpo bo sɔ́ xota ɖé ɖò Rockbox mɛ (Nǔjlajla lɛ > Nǔjlajla Xóta ɔ Tɔn lɛ).
themepack_err_not_found: É sixu mɔ alǒ bɛ́ .rockbox sín wěma ɖé ɖò mɔ̌to e è sɔ́ é jí ǎ. Mi kɛnklɛn bo hɛn ayi mitɔn ɖo te ɖɔ mi ze folder ɖokpo ɖo player mitɔn ji.
rockbox_wizard_title: Rockbox 360p Xóta lɛ kpo Wemafɔ lɛ kpo sín Sɔ́
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Afɔ 1gɔ́ ɔ: Vɔ nǔxixo ɔ bɛ́ bo lɛ́vɔ cá .
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Mi ɖe kàn USB ɔ tɔn.
2. Mi hɛn hlɔnhlɔn nu ayihunmlimlixotɔ ɔ bo jo e do bɔ e na jɛ Rockbox mɛ.
3. Enyi Rockbox ɖò azɔ̌ wà wɛ ɔ, vɔ́ kàn USB ɔ cá, enɛ gudo hǔn, zǐn Continuer.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Afɔ 2: Mi ɖo ayihunmlimlixotɔ ɔ ba wɛ gbɔn ADB ji...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App ɔ ɖò ADB sín kancica ɖé kpɔ́n wɛ (kaka jɛ segɔndu 30 jí). Enyi è mɔ nǔ e è nɔ zán é ɖé ɔ, è nɔ sɔ́ xota lɛ dó tɛn ɖevo mɛ bɔ nǔxixo ɔ nɔ lɛ́vɔ bɛ́ azɔ̌ éɖesunɔ. Enyi mɔ̌ ǎ ɔ, zǐn nukɔn bo yì Mode Storage USB jí.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: E ɖo te kpɔn ADB sin azɔwanu... (kaka jɛ ceju 30)
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: È mɔ nǔ ADB tɔn ɖě ɖò segɔndu 30 vlamɛ ǎ; ɖò nukɔn yì wɛ kpo Mode Storage USB kpo.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: ADB binaire ɖebu ɖo appli ɔ mɛ ǎ; ɖò nukɔn yì wɛ kpo Mode Storage USB kpo.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Mi ɖo xota lɛ kpodo wemafɔ lɛ kpo ɖo ADB ji...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB sín ɖiɖe gló; é lɛ́vɔ jɛ USB sín Nǔhɛ́ntɛn .
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Mi zé ɖ'ayi gbɔn USB jí
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Mi hun USB Storage Mode ɖò nǔxixotɔ́ ɔ jí bonu é ni tɔ́n ɖi mɔ̌to ɖé ɖɔhun.
2. Sɔ́ xójlawema ƉEBU ɖò nǔxixotɔ́ e ɖò dò é jí (.rockbox, Han, Xóta lɛ, alǒ xójlawema ɔ sín dò — xójlawema .rockbox e ɖò hwlahwlá é ɖé nɔ ɖò éɖesunɔ jí).
3. App ɔ nɔ xò xota 360p lɛ kpo wekwín lɛ kpo kplé ɖò, bo nɔ wlan nǔ dó wema e ɖó nyikɔ ɖokpo ɔ lɛ é jí.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Dìn ɔ, a sixu ɖè nǔxixo ɔ sín kàn ɔ jí kpo ayijayǐ kpo bo sɔ́ xota ɖé ɖò Rockbox mɛ (Nǔjlajla lɛ > Nǔjlajla Xóta ɔ Tɔn lɛ).
